title: macOS Reviewer and Linux same-volume cold recovery of an active CardputerDict ADV review

execution.environment: macOS system Python 3.9.6 and authenticated Virtio VSOCK to a no-NIC Linux VM

checks.detail: Same authenticated loopback endpoint across boots; actual 401 authentication and 403 scope controls
HTTP 409 is the expected fence; one retained lease, writable Flash, durable intent and matching old PCAP
Exact controller stop acknowledgment and out-of-state read-only receipt; old lease, writable Flash and Reviewer create intent released; old journals and capture unchanged
Fresh same-original standard retry 202 then SIM_VERIFIED; 10,605-byte SD MP3, 84,992-byte I2S PCM and paired evidence ZIP integrity and payload matches
Both owned VMs and relays acknowledged stopped, zero leases and no owned open paths
Isolated same-volume rehearsal, no production routing or current Reviewer 0.29 path in this execution
No physical device or host power-loss measurements

notes: The first two startup errors are fixture-only and occurred before a review was started.
The successful runtime receipts and cleanup were preserved. A post-run collector type error was resolved by a separate offline readback without another boot.
